_doc: Controlled vocabulary for input-remapper issue analysis. Generic facets (kind, ctype, outcome, conf, os, impact) transfer from the playbook starter. Domain facets (layer, cause, component, device_type, de_os, pr_potential, symptom) are input-remapper-specific. Review after reading the first 100 issue titles (P05 evolve step).

values.regression: used to work, broke after a code or system update
values.feature-request: asks for new behaviour that does not exist
values.question: asks how something works (usage, config, keysyms)
values.meta: about the project itself (governance, naming, packaging)
values.spam: noise, off-topic, duplicate, empty or test issue

layer.doc: Where in the system the problem sits

values.reader: event reader (reads raw events from input devices via evdev)
values.injector: event injector (writes events to virtual uinput device)
values.mapping: mapping and preset logic (translates one event to another)
values.config: configuration and preset files (storage, migration, format)
values.permissions: udev rules, uinput access, group membership, capabilities

cause.doc: Root cause — use unknown when not established; grow this list as you read

values.regression: broke after a code change in input-remapper
values.wayland-issue: Wayland-specific behaviour or missing protocol support
values.de-compat: desktop environment compatibility (KDE, GNOME, XFCE quirk)
values.permission: missing udev rules, uinput device access, group membership
values.evdev-api: evdev API usage or kernel evdev behaviour
values.uinput-api: uinput API usage or virtual device handling
values.python-version: Python version incompatibility or dependency version
values.race-condition: timing or ordering issue in daemon or reader
values.missing-feature: requested functionality does not exist (feeds feature-request kind)
values.distro-compat: distro-specific packaging, init system or path issue
values.macro-logic: bug in macro expression parsing or execution
values.combination-logic: key combination detection or matching defect
values.ui-logic: GTK UI logic or state management defect
values.symbol-mapping: wrong or missing keysym, evdev type or code

device_type.doc: What type of input device is involved

values.fixed: fixed in a code or docs commit
values.workaround: a workaround was given or found
values.docs-answer: answered by pointing to existing docs
values.duplicate: closed as duplicate of another issue
values.stale: open but long inactive (no activity 6+ months)

pr_potential.doc: Actionability: how likely a PR could close this. Filled after reading; assessed for the current state of the fork (grenudi/input-remapper). This facet is the bridge between the dataset and the contribution plan.

values.code-fix: a targeted code change would close it (small to medium effort)
values.docs-fix: a documentation update or in-app hint would close it
values.needs-design: needs architectural discussion or maintainer buy-in before a PR
values.upstream-dep: root cause is upstream (kernel, evdev, GTK, Wayland protocol); fix requires upstream change
values.close-duplicate: should be closed as duplicate; no code needed
values.wontfix: maintainer would likely decline; not actionable

values.broken-remap: remapping has no effect at all
values.partial-remap: remapping works sometimes, in some conditions, or partially
values.crash: daemon or GUI crashes or hangs
values.install-blocked: cannot install, start, or enable the service
values.perf: input lag, CPU use or resource problem
values.ui-bug: GUI cosmetic or workflow problem (does not affect remapping itself)

symptom.doc: What the reporter observed — weak labels derived from text; a search aid, not a diagnosis

values.mapping-not-working: remapping or injection has no visible effect
values.key-stuck: key stays pressed or repeats unexpectedly
values.daemon-not-starting: input-remapper-service will not start or exits immediately
values.gui-crash: the GTK UI crashes, freezes or fails to open
values.permission-error: permission denied accessing uinput or device node
values.wrong-output: wrong key, button or axis value is emitted
values.combination-not-firing: a key combination does not trigger as configured
values.macro-error: macro fails to parse or execute
values.device-not-detected: the input device does not appear in the UI or reader
values.install-fail: installation, pip install or package manager step fails
values.wayland-broken: works on X11 but broken or not functional on Wayland
values.service-unit-issue: systemd service file, enable/disable or autostart problem
